description: This PHP class defines a specific filter field for employee education in a reporting module of OrangeHRM. It allows adding a condition to a query based on the selected education, retrieves related education entity information, and converts this information into an array format.

classes.name: EmployeeEducation
classes.description: A filter field class for employee education used in report query filtering, capable of adding conditions to the query and retrieving education info.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a condition to the query builder to filter employees by education if the operator is EQUAL and an education id (X) is provided.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the aliases used for the entity in query joins, here 'education'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Returns an array with the education entity's id and label if found, else null.
